vc_checking.summary: All seven target manual witnesses are semantically proofable under the current annotation and seed case_lib. The five implementation VCs share one first-occurrence circular-DLL split/rejoin family, including nil/nonempty suffix classification. The two derived-contract VCs specialize dispatch_case to the unchanged abstract list and discharge the wand by sentinel/member branch reduction. No annotation or seed-spec repair is required. Two pure list helpers are likely useful for the entail witness; spatial split/join and sentinel-exclusion facts can be proved locally inside witness bodies or, if the worker prefers, as group-suffixed proved helpers.

proof_groups.grouping_reason: Five witnesses share one first-occurrence cut and inverse DLL-segment reclosure family. Keeping them together lets one worker reuse local split/join proof patterns; size 5 is within max_witnesses_per_group=12.
proof_groups.proof_strategy: For entail_wit_1 split the anchor, open xizi_dll, choose a first occurrence in the member branch, inductively split xizi_dllseg, and use the two suffixed pure helpers for the dispatch equation. For return_wit_1 classify the complete start=stop segment as nil and close. For return_wit_2 classify the member suffix as nil, locally rejoin prefix/node/suffix, and close. For return_wit_3 expose the nonempty suffix head, use the same local rejoin, and close. For return_wit_4 expose the nonempty complete-list head and close. Keep spatial Hsplit/Hjoin/Hstopnil/Hstartcons and address-distinctness arguments local unless the worker deliberately proves suffixed case_lib helpers. Do not use any forbidden lemma.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: Treat the heap as one circular DLL cut at either the sentinel or the queried member. The returned value is the first abstract address of the suffix: nil gives NULL and cons gives the stored successor. Rejoining the same cut preserves all ownership.
